easy.formula: beds plus one isolation bed per ward = wrd bpw + wrd
neighbouring bed pairs, beds in a line per ward = wrd (bpw - 1)
doctor visits: every bed twice and every ward once = 2 wrd bpw + wrd
shifts worked plus 3 cover shifts a week = nrs sft + 3
bottles for every pill = ceil(pil / ppb)
cases for those bottles = ceil(ceil(pil / ppb) / bpc)
cases of full bottles = (pil // ppb) // bpc
pills left over after full bottles = pil mod ppb
printed pages with a 4-page cover = cps (pgs + 4)
proof pages: the whole book twice plus one page per copy = 2 pgs + cps
press sheets for lfs leaves, ups up = ceil(lfs / ups)
frame round the poster plus a 2-unit hanger = 2 (pstw + psth) + 2
sum of the squared sides = pstw^2 + psth^2
crane moves: unload and reload every box = 2 shp cbx
fendered edge: two lengths and one width = 2 dkl + dkw
quay plus a 1-unit kerb strip on the length = dkw dkl + 2 dkl
bins for every cargo unit = ceil(crg / upb)
trucks of full bins = (crg // upb) // bpk
full bins left after full trucks = (crg // upb) mod bpk

hard.formula: doses with one spare per patient = pat (dpd trd + 1)
a double first-day dose = pat dpd (trd + 1)
last two days at one dose = pat (dpd (trd - 2) + 2)
treatment weeks started = ceil(trd / 7), for pat patients
ordered moves between wards = bpw wrd (wrd - 1)
handovers between nurses = nrs (nrs - 1) / 2, sft weeks
hours: 8 per shift plus 1 handover hour per nurse = 8 nrs sft + nrs
teams of 4 nurses, rounded up, per shift = sft ceil(nrs / 4)
pills a case holds minus those packed in the last case = ppb bpc - pil mod (ppb bpc)
sheets, two pages a sheet, per copy = cps ceil(pgs / 2)
facing-page spreads per book = pgs // 2 - 1, over cps copies
16-page signatures per copy, rounded up = cps ceil(pgs / 16)
reams of rms hundred sheets = ceil(ceil(lfs / ups) / (100 rms))
sheets with 10 make-ready sheets per ream started = ceil(lfs/ups) + 10 rms
a 1-unit trim margin all round = pstw psth - (pstw - 2)(psth - 2)
A-size tiles 3 by 4 needed = ceil(pstw / 3) ceil(psth / 4)
mount board with a 2-unit border = (pstw + 4)(psth + 4)
pages in the set plus 2 endpapers a volume = vol (sgv pps + 2)
stitches: 3 per signature and 2 per volume = 3 vol sgv + 2 vol
folded quarter-sheets: vol sgv (pps // 4)
index entries: one per page and one per signature = vol sgv pps + vol sgv
mooring lines: 6 per ship plus 1 per 50 boxes rounded up = 6 shp + ceil(cbx/50)
ship pairs plus box total = shp(shp-1)/2 + shp cbx
stacks 5 high per ship = shp ceil(cbx / 5)
lifts with a 1-hour break per crane = crn lph (wkh - 1)
first hour at half rate: crn (lph wkh - lph // 2)
8-hour shifts per crane, rounded up = crn ceil(wkh / 8)
lifts plus 2 safety checks per crane-hour = crn wkh (lph + 2)
quay less a 2-unit lane round it = (dkw - 4)(dkl - 4)
bollards every 5 units along both lengths, plus corners = 2 (dkl // 5) + 4
trucks for those bins = ceil(ceil(crg / upb) / bpk)
